run_evaluate_chamfer: run the evaluate function to compute chamfer distance for reconstructed meshes against ground truth samples
run_evaluate_cli: run evaluate.py with --experiment, --data, and --split flags to evaluate a DeepSDF autodecoder checkpoint
review_evaluate_function: review the evaluate function that iterates over a split JSON to compute chamfer distances per shape
summarize_evaluate_workflow: summarize the evaluate workflow that loads ground truth PLY files, reconstructed meshes, and normalization params to compute metrics
test_evaluate_chamfer_csv: test the evaluate function output by verifying the chamfer.csv file is written with shape and distance columns
